newsitem.title: USA: Reopening of Con Edison proceedings sought.
newsitem.headline: Reopening of Con Edison proceedings sought.

text.p: New York State's Attorney General wants the Public Service Commission to reopen proceedings in the Consolidated Edison Co of New York Inc Competitive Opportunities Settlement.

The attorney general's office said a petition to reopen the case was filed with the commission saying its decision to limit the public comment period to just two months, instead of the usual 11, prevented full public review of the plan.

Howerver, another state agency, the Consumer Protection Board disagreed, saying this would only delay further the implementation of competition and the resulting benefits to consumers in Con Ed's service territory.

Noting the board's previously announced opposition to the Con Edison settlement as it's currently structured, Consumer Protection Board Chief Timothy Carey said, "We believe that the framework set up by the PSC eliciting public comment on the proposal has given any interested party or individual consumer the time to formulate their position and the forum to submit their suggestions for improvement to the PSC."
